summary: Elk City Regional Business Airport is a small general aviation facility serving Elk City in western Oklahoma. The airport supports regional business travel and recreational flying in Beckham County, located along historic Route 66. It features a single asphalt runway and provides a convenient alternative to larger commercial airports in the region.
faqs:
Q: What is the airport code for Elk City Regional Business Airport?
A: The airport is designated ELK by IATA and KELK by ICAO.

Q: Does Elk City Regional Business Airport offer commercial airline service?
A: No, this is a general aviation airport with no scheduled commercial flights.

Q: How many runways does the airport have?
A: The airport has a single asphalt runway suitable for small to mid-size general aviation aircraft.

Q: Where is the airport located relative to the city?
A: The airport is situated on the outskirts of Elk City, providing easy access to the community and surrounding western Oklahoma region.
transport_tips: Ground transportation options are limited, so arranging a rental car or pickup in advance is recommended. The airport is just a short drive from downtown Elk City and US-40/I-40. Visitors flying in should coordinate with local contacts or lodging providers for transportation, as there is no public transit service.
local_tip: Time your visit to coincide with the annual Elk City Rodeo of Champions, one of the oldest rodeos in Oklahoma held each June, which draws visitors from across the region.
